declared.signatureBytes: Deliberately invalid fixed DATA; no cryptographic signature.

notExecuted: nonce search or actual SDK PREPARE
restoration: Exact retained header only; DATA comparison is not a new signature, funding acknowledgement, grant or delivery receipt.
recovery: Local observation only. Missing originals, funding ambiguity, uncertainty or any prior dispatch/response require reconciliation; later clean DATA cannot clear the latch.
service: Explicit restore plus fresh caller pins and unchanged stored never-attempted original required. Real native owner still validates the proof and custody. Promise<void> is callback completion only.
output: Last exact result line retained in memory before write. No automatic write replay, restore replay, re-sign, replacement or service retry.
close: One cooperative command-session close observation budget. Late completion does not heal HELD or rewrite historical close.
